From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Quick follow-up: POC kickoff & next steps

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through AcmeAI's goals for the POC. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference at 2k QPS latency SLOs on your tagging pipeline and measure per-token cost savings with caching/batching.
- Success criteria: < 200ms p50 for inference, >=30% cost reduction vs baseline, integration with your staging S3 and CI.
- Next steps (we proposed):
  1) You provide staging API keys and S3 access for data subset (I can share a scoped checklist).
  2) Rafael to run an initial capacity/instance sizing run and propose config.
  3) We deliver a 2-week POC environment and a mutual action plan (MAP).

I attached a short POC-Kickoff-Guide with the checklist and a draft SOW to speed approvals. Can you confirm access timelines? If this is still a priority for next week we can kick off Monday.

Attachments: [Attachment: POC-Kickoff-Guide.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: SOW-Draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Thanks — let me know what timing works and if you'd like me to loop in an infra engineer earlier.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa —

Apologies for the slow reply. We've had a last-minute priority shift (security review for a separate project) and I haven't been able to get the staging credentials pulled together yet. We're still interested, but can we do the following to keep momentum without full access right away?

1) Can you run a lightweight eval on a 10k-record sample (we can share CSV) so we can get a rough cost/latency estimate without opening staging?
2) Can we compress the scope to the primary tagging endpoint for the initial week?

I'll try to get you the sample by EOD Wednesday. If there's an internal form/process you need filled for access, ping me and I'll escalate.
